description: POST /conversation/create composes BotRefOrConfig. Its oneOf branches BotRef and BotConfig both permit arbitrary additional properties and have no required fields. A documented body containing botId therefore validates against both branches and is rejected by oneOf. The node sends the documented botId reference unchanged.

GET /conversation/{conversationId}/fetch composes the same overlapping BotRefOrConfig oneOf, so the harness cannot generate a spec-valid object response, even though the provider documents a complete conversation object including botId. The request route and Bearer header conform; the parser accepts the documented object shape.
